<script>
document.querySelectorAll(".bd-copy").forEach(function (btn) {
  btn.addEventListener("click", function () {
    var text = btn.parentElement.querySelector("p").innerText;
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(function () {
      btn.textContent = "Kopiert";
      btn.classList.add("bd-copy--done");
      setTimeout(function () {
        btn.textContent = "Kopier";
        btn.classList.remove("bd-copy--done");
